text:
maria: quick UX q — we need a console 'preview' / dry-run for automatic fallback policies. idea: run against a day's traffic slice and show which routes would have fallen back and why. who wants to prototype what the UX should show?
dan: scope? per-route only or global policy preview too? and do we expect replayable samples or just aggregated stats?
sasha: per-route + global rollup. UI should show: simulated fallback count, top 3 reasons, estimated latency/cost delta if applied, and a small list of anonymized sample requests. put a Figma link in the card. :point_right: https://figma.com/s/mvp-preview
lee: privacy + cost concerns. we cannot store full requests by default. must be anonymized payloads + opt-in retention toggle. sampling required.
asha: agree. telemetry needs a clear schema: `fallback.trigger` (error|load|quota|cache), `fallback.reason_code`, `simulated:true/false`. Also show a short human-friendly explanation for each reason.
dash: proto event we can emit from runtime for preview mode — puts a toggle `simulated=true` on the audit event. example:
```json
{
  "event_type": "fallback",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "trigger": "latency_threshold",
  "reason_code": "LAT_THRESH_5s",
  "simulated": true,
  "sample_id": "abc123"
}
```
sasha: UI microcopy: badge "Preview (simulated)" next to the policy name, toaster: "This preview will not change live routing". add a CTA: "Replay in sandbox" for audited samples.
lee: sampling heuristics — 100% dry-run is too expensive. propose: default 1% sampling, with options: 1%, 5%, or targeted sampling (errors only). need SRE sign-off on cost.
maria: MVP proposal: per-route preview, default 5% sampling for 24h, store anonymized samples for 30 days, show aggregated metrics (count, top reasons, p95 latency delta, est cost delta), and up to 10 replayable anonymized samples. @qa-sam can you own test plan?
qa-sam: on it. test matrix: sample rates, anonymization check, audit events surface in telemetry pipeline (kinesis -> s3), replay button spawns a sandboxed request, and ensure `simulated=true` flag persists. will include e2e for canary vs full rollout.
asha: operator overrides: if someone flips a policy live from the preview screen, that action must generate an audit event with operator id + reason. require 2FA for prod override? maybe a modal asking for confirmation.
dan: API notes i'll draft: POST /policies/:id/preview -> returns preview_id, status, metrics link. GET /preview/:id/samples -> paginated, anonymized list. POST /preview/:id/replay/:sample_id -> enqueue replay in sandbox. will add `simulated` to returned events.
ops-bot: [system] staging deploy succeeded for rtp/preview-service (build: preview-2026-03-20).
maria: sweet. dan — can you sketch wireframes with the metrics card + sample list? aim for a lightweight left rail panel and a big metrics card center. i'll sync with product PM after your draft. :thumbsup:
dan: yep — i'll do a quick figma draft today and drop link. will also create a small spec for retention/time-to-live on the audit events.
asha: one more: telemetry column names should be stable (no ad-hoc strings). propose: `event_type`, `route`, `policy_id`, `trigger`, `reason_code`, `simulated`, `sample_id`, `anonymized:true`. that'll make downstream queries easier.
maria: perfect. pairing session tomorrow 11am to combine API + UX + SRE cost estimate. thanks all.
